mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sc_raw_status_observation (observation_no, observation_key, source_type, operation_id, b_order_id, connector_version_id, external_order_no, external_status, external_sub_status, mapping_definition_id, mapped_result_class, payload_digest, observed_at, received_at, trace_id) VALUES (#{observation.observationNo}, #{observation.observationKey}, #{observation.sourceType}, #{observation.operationId}, #{observation.bOrderId}, #{observation.connectorVersionId}, #{observation.externalOrderNo}, #{observation.externalStatus}, #{observation.externalSubStatus}, #{observation.mappingDefinitionId}, #{observation.mappedResultClass}, #{observation.payloadDigest}, #{observation.observedAt}, #{observation.receivedAt}, #{observation.traceId}) AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE observation_key = IF(sc_raw_status_observation.observation_key = incoming.observation_key, sc_raw_status_observation.observation_key, NULL)
